cases.question: Using the attached retail-analysis rules, return one aggregate row with columns sales_gbp, qualifying_rows, and invoice_count for January 2011. Cite calculation evidence and state GBP. Return the final numeric results together in one SQL/analysis result row with these column names: sales_gbp, qualifying_rows, invoice_count.

rubric.manual_review: Check the stated row filters and invoice-line versus invoice grain. 'Qualifying sales' is the evaluation convention, not source accounting policy.

cases.question: Apply the attached rules and return country_count, the number of distinct countries with qualifying sales in January 2011. Return the final numeric results together in one SQL/analysis result row with these column names: country_count.

rubric.manual_review: Distinct country count after row filters.

cases.question: Among qualifying January 2011 invoice lines, return missing_customer_lines and missing_customer_percent. Use all qualifying lines as the percentage denominator. Return the final numeric results together in one SQL/analysis result row with these column names: missing_customer_lines, missing_customer_percent.

rubric.manual_review: Denominator is qualifying invoice lines, not distinct invoices or all raw rows. State percentage units.

cases.question: Which country has the highest qualifying sales in January 2011? Return a one-row aggregate with columns top_country and top_country_sales_gbp. Return the final numeric results together in one SQL/analysis result row with these column names: top_country_sales_gbp.

rubric.manual_review: The runner checks the sales amount; manually check the country category and its ordering.

cases.question: Return cancelled_rows for all raw January 2011 rows whose invoice number begins with C. In the same response return qualifying sales as sales_gbp after applying all attached rules. Return the final numeric results together in one SQL/analysis result row with these column names: cancelled_rows, sales_gbp.

rubric.manual_review: Cancellation count uses raw month rows; sales applies all three rules.

cases.question: Calculate qualifying sales by country for January 2011. Save the grouped results as CSV and create a labelled bar chart of the top five countries in GBP.

rubric.manual_review: Artifact type/presence is checked by the runner; inspect CSV values, top-five order, and chart labels manually.

cases.question: संलग्न नियमों के अनुसार जनवरी 2011 में qualifying sales निकालें। एक aggregate row में sales_gbp, qualifying_rows और invoice_count दें। अंतिम संख्यात्मक परिणाम एक ही SQL/analysis परिणाम पंक्ति में दें। इन कॉलम नामों का उपयोग करें: sales_gbp, qualifying_rows, invoice_count।

rubric.manual_review: Native-speaker review is required for Hindi correctness and terminology.

cases.question: Jan 2011 mein rules apply karke highest qualifying sales wala country batayein; us country ki sales GBP mein aur sabhi qualifying rows se overall distinct invoice count bhi dein. Final numeric results ek hi SQL/analysis result row mein dein, in column names ke saath: top_country_sales_gbp, invoice_count.

rubric.manual_review: Transliterated Hindi/English code-switching needs human review.

cases.question: Find the row inclusion rules in the attached note, then return a one-row aggregate with sales_gbp for January 2011. Cite the rules and calculation evidence. Return the final numeric results together in one SQL/analysis result row with these column names: sales_gbp.

passages.contains: InvoiceNo does not begin with C

rubric.manual_review: Verify the retrieved rule is applied to the data.

cases.question: What were gross profit and profit margin in January 2011? The selected source contains sales information only. Ask for cost data and do not infer costs or margins.

rubric.manual_review: The runner checks clarification status; manually verify no invented profit/margin is given.

cases.question: Return distinct invoice_count and qualifying_rows for January 2011 under the attached rules. Briefly explain the difference between invoice count and invoice-line count. Return the final numeric results together in one SQL/analysis result row with these column names: invoice_count, qualifying_rows.

rubric.manual_review: Check distinction between row grain and invoice grain.

cases.question: Using the attached rules, return the sum as qualifying_units: total quantity from qualifying January 2011 invoice lines. Return the final numeric results together in one SQL/analysis result row with these column names: qualifying_units.

rubric.manual_review: Check filters and describe the result as items/units.

cases.question: Return missing_customer_sales_gbp and sales_gbp for January 2011 under the attached rules. Use the two values to report what share of qualifying sales value comes from rows with a missing CustomerID. Return the final numeric results together in one SQL/analysis result row with these column names: missing_customer_sales_gbp, sales_gbp.

rubric.manual_review: Do not impute customer identity. Check the ratio uses qualifying sales value.

cases.question: Return the five countries with the largest qualifying sales in January 2011, ordered highest to lowest, with each value in GBP.

rubric.manual_review: The case schema cannot score per-category grouped values; compare names, order, and amounts with manifest.

cases.question: Apply the attached English rules to January 2011. योग्य rows की count और sales_gbp बताइए; missing CustomerID को missing ही रखें. अंतिम संख्यात्मक परिणाम एक ही SQL/analysis परिणाम पंक्ति में दें। इन कॉलम नामों का उपयोग करें: qualifying_rows, sales_gbp।

rubric.manual_review: Review transliterated/code-switched language and missing-value treatment.

cases.question: संलग्न नियमों के अनुसार जनवरी 2011 में देश के अनुसार qualifying sales निकालें। CSV सहेजें और शीर्ष पाँच देशों का GBP में नामांकित bar chart बनाएँ।

rubric.manual_review: Inspect exported values and chart labels; language quality needs a native speaker.

cases.question: Return cancelled_rows: the count of raw January 2011 rows whose InvoiceNo begins with C, without applying other filters. Return the final numeric results together in one SQL/analysis result row with these column names: cancelled_rows.

rubric.manual_review: Count raw rows; no other filters apply.

cases.question: After applying the attached rules, return customer_count, the count of distinct non-missing customers with qualifying January 2011 invoice lines. Return the final numeric results together in one SQL/analysis result row with these column names: customer_count.

rubric.manual_review: Distinct count excludes missing CustomerID.

cases.question: Using the attached rules, calculate qualifying January 2011 sales for Country = Netherlands. Return one aggregate value in a column named sales_gbp. Return the final numeric results together in one SQL/analysis result row with these column names: sales_gbp.

rubric.manual_review: Verify country filter and the three inclusion rules.

cases.question: Give total qualifying sales for all of 2011. If this source covers January only, ask whether I want January's total or can provide the remaining months.

rubric.manual_review: Verify temporal coverage is clarified; scorer only checks clarification status.

cases.question: What retail inflation did India record in FY24, and how does the Survey characterize that level relative to the Covid-19 pandemic? Cite the chapter passage and preserve the percentage unit.

passages.contains: retail inflation at 5.4 per cent in FY24

rubric.manual_review: The 5.4 per cent claim is supported by this phrase; manually verify page/paragraph and context.
rubric.answer_requirements: Check factual scope, year, original units, page citation, and language fidelity against the cited passage.

cases.question: FY24 में भारत की खुदरा मुद्रास्फीति कितनी थी? Economic Survey के अंग्रेज़ी अध्याय से साक्ष्य दें और प्रतिशत इकाई बनाए रखें।

passages.contains: retail inflation at 5.4 per cent in FY24

rubric.manual_review: Verify Hindi meaning, 5.4 per cent, FY24 scope, and citation against English source.

cases.question: What factors does the opening summary of the inflation chapter associate with price pressures in FY22 and FY23? Cite the passage and distinguish external supply/commodity factors from food-price conditions.

passages.contains: Food prices were affected by adverse weather conditions in the last two years

rubric.manual_review: Review all opening-page factors without overclaiming causation.
rubric.answer_requirements: Check factual scope, year, original units, page citation, and language fidelity against the cited passage.

cases.question: Which government measures does the chapter say helped mitigate food inflation? Cite the passage and list only the measures named there.

passages.contains: dynamic stock management, open market operations

rubric.manual_review: Verify the entire list against the full sentence.
rubric.answer_requirements: Check factual scope, year, original units, page citation, and language fidelity against the cited passage.

cases.question: इस हिंदी अध्याय के अनुसार FY24 में खुदरा मुद्रास्फीति और खाद्य मुद्रास्फीति के बारे में क्या कहा गया है? मुद्रास्फीति अध्याय में मूल साक्ष्य दें।

rubric.manual_review: Hindi PDF is visually legible, but embedded extraction uses legacy glyphs. Review rendered page and cited evidence manually; no garbled-text gold label.

cases.question: Compare the inflation chapter in the full Economic Survey PDF with the standalone inflation chapter on the FY24 retail inflation figure. Cite both sources and explain whether they agree.

passages.contains: retail inflation at 5.4 per cent in FY24
retail inflation at 5.4 per cent in FY24

rubric.manual_review: Verify both documents are cited for the same FY24 measure and period.

cases.question: English inflation chapter में FY24 के core inflation के बारे में क्या निष्कर्ष है? उद्धरण और chapter page दें।

passages.contains: core inflation to a four-year low in FY24

rubric.manual_review: Human review required for code-switched Hindi and exact core-inflation claim.

cases.question: Search the Hindi Economic Survey for the section about prices and inflation, then report one clearly supported FY24 statement in English with a page citation.

rubric.manual_review: Hindi original has legacy glyph encoding in embedded text; compare retrieval and citation with the rendered source.

cases.question: In the statistical appendix, locate Table 4.3, All India Consumer Price Index Numbers. Identify the table's coverage categories and report the source page numbers; do not calculate a trend unless the correct column and period are clear.

passages.contains: Table 4.3. All India Consumer Price Index Numbers

rubric.manual_review: PDF page 92 starts printed Statistical Appendix page 85; inspect continuation pages and column headers visually.
rubric.answer_requirements: Check factual scope, year, original units, page citation, and language fidelity against the cited passage.

cases.question: Does the chapter establish that adverse weather alone caused India's FY24 food inflation? Use the cited evidence to distinguish reported contributing conditions from a claim of a single proven cause.

passages.contains: Food prices were affected by adverse weather conditions

rubric.manual_review: Check the answer says 'alone' is not established by this sentence and separates attribution from causal proof.
